agents.name: backend-engineer
agents.role: Go backend and observability-instrumentation implementation — runnable, tested, instrumented services

agents.name: data-architect
agents.role: Data layer design authority — physical models, canonical model, event schemas, pipelines, classification, lineage, retention

agents.name: data-engineer
agents.role: Data Engineering — pipeline implementation, data quality, product analytics

agents.name: domain-modeler
agents.role: Domain Modelling — Bounded Contexts, Domain Events, Aggregates, CQRS model

agents.name: enterprise-architect
agents.role: Architecture Design — service decomposition, diagrams, API contracts, ADRs

agents.name: frontend-engineer
agents.role: React + TypeScript frontend implementation across a shell + microfrontend-remotes architecture — type-sound, accessible, performant, observable UI

agents.name: platform-engineer
agents.role: Platform Engineering — CI/CD, IaC, Kubernetes delivery, observability stack, SLOs, DR, runbooks

agents.name: product-strategist
agents.role: Product Strategy — full Strategy phase ownership

agents.name: requirements-analyst
agents.role: Requirements & Discovery — Ideate phase ownership; Customer Validation phase ownership

agents.name: security-architect
agents.role: Security Design — threat model, Zero Trust, ABAC, privacy, compliance-as-code design

agents.name: security-engineer
agents.role: Security Implementation — Go security controls, compliance tests, evidence pipeline

agents.name: test-strategist
agents.role: SDET — test discipline, Test Pyramid, BDD feature files, and cross-cutting system tests

agents.name: ux-architect
agents.role: UX design authority — journey maps, information architecture, user flows, and UI component specifications (Shared and Local)
